question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Characteristic
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Characteristic"** means a feature or quality belonging typically to a person, place, or thing and serving to identify them. (विशेषता)

 
 
• **Example:** One **characteristic **of successful people is their ability to persevere through challenges.
 
 
 
• **"Usual"** refers to something that is common or typical, something that happens or is done most of the time. (सामान्य)
 
 
• **Example:** It is** usual **for him to have a cup of coffee in the morning.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Characteristic'** is **'Usual'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Distinctive** (विशिष्ट): Characteristic of one person or thing, and so serving to distinguish it from others.

 
 
• **Example:** The **distinctive** sound of her voice makes her easy to recognize on the phone.
 
 
 
• **Inbred** (वंशानुगत): Existing from birth or by inherent nature.
 
 
• **Example:** His** inbred **talent for music was evident from a young age.
 
 
 
• **Affordable** (किफायती): Inexpensive; reasonably priced.
 
 
• **Example:** The store offers a wide range of** affordable **products.
